title: C¹ local inverse on open images near a point where the derivative is invertible
statement: Let X and Y be real normed spaces with X complete. Let U ⊆ X be open, z₀ ∈ U, and Φ : X → Y be C¹ on U. Suppose Φ has Fréchet derivative Λ at z₀, where Λ : X → Y is a continuous linear equivalence. Then there are ρ > 0 and a map G : Y → X such that: the open ball B_ρ(z₀) ⊆ U; G(Φ(z)) = z for every z ∈ B_ρ(z₀); and for every open set W ⊆ B_ρ(z₀), the image Φ(W) is open and G is C¹ on Φ(W).
lean_statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] (Φ : X → Y) (U : Set X) (z₀ : X) (Λ : X ≃L[ℝ] Y), IsOpen U → z₀ ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ U → HasFDerivAt Φ (Λ : X →L[ℝ] Y) z₀ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball z₀ ρ ⊆ U ∧ ∃ G : Y → X, (∀ z ∈ ball z₀ ρ, G (Φ z) = z) ∧ ∀ W : Set X, W ⊆ ball z₀ ρ → IsOpen W → IsOpen (Φ '' W) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G (Φ '' W)
